title: Full-stack web app (Python Flask + SQLite)
description: Flask server with a JSON REST API backed by SQLite, a server-rendered page with vanilla JS front end, and tests. Good base for dashboards, internal tools and CRUD apps.
produces: Web server app deployable to any Python host (Render, Fly.io, a VPS with gunicorn)
build: Build mode creates .venv, installs Flask and runs the tests. Deploy with: gunicorn 'app:create_app()'
customize: templates/index.html + static/app.js: the page and the fetch() calls to the API
tests/test_app.py: API tests using Flask's test client
